_comment: Synchronized from OpenAPI by `SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo run -- generate-mcp-docs`. Existing MCP wording is preserved; use `--force` to regenerate everything.

arguments.community_id: Community ID (the `id` of a community in list_servers), or "all" for every community combined.

get_community_player_count_graph.description:
Unique player count over time for a community, or globally.

Use `community_id = "all"` for the combined graph across every community. `time_type`
picks the bucket width (`TenMinutes`, `OneHour`, `OneDay`) and `time` anchors the most
recent bucket; up to 31 buckets before it are returned.
get_community_player_count_graph.title: Get Community Player Count Graph

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_analysis.description:
Performance metrics for a map: dropoff rate, average session length and similar. Backed
by `MapWorker`'s cache.
get_map_analysis.title: Get Map Analysis

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_heat_regions.description:
Per-day geographic heat map data for a map's player activity. Backed by `MapWorker`'s
cache.
get_map_heat_regions.title: Get Map Heat Regions

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_info.description: Detailed metadata for a single map on a server. Backed by `MapWorker`'s cache.
get_map_info.title: Get Map Info

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_player_types.description:
Time breakdown by player type (e.g. casual vs tryhard) for a map. Backed by
`MapWorker`'s cache.
get_map_player_types.title: Get Map Player Types

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_regions.description: Geographic region breakdown for a map's players. Backed by `MapWorker`'s cache.
get_map_regions.title: Get Map Regions

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_session_distribution.description:
Distribution of session lengths for a map (how long players typically stay). Backed by
`MapWorker`'s cache.
get_map_session_distribution.title: Get Map Session Distribution

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.
arguments.session_id: Session ID: a map session's time_id (get_map_sessions) or a player session's id (get_player_sessions), matching the tool.

get_map_session_player_count_graph.description:
Player-count chart for a single map session.

Returns the player-count time series for the given map play (`session_id`) on that
server, downsampled to at most 1500 peak-preserving points. Cached briefly while the map
is still being played, for a long time once it has ended.
get_map_session_player_count_graph.title: Get Map Session Player Count Graph

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.
arguments.session_id: Session ID: a map session's time_id (get_map_sessions) or a player session's id (get_player_sessions), matching the tool.

get_map_session_players.description:
Players (and their playtime during it) for a single map-play session, ranked by time.

Anonymized players are handled per the requester's identity. Cached briefly while the
map is still being played, for a day once it has ended.
get_map_session_players.title: Get Map Session Players

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_sessions.description:
Paginated list of a single map's play sessions on a server, newest first.

Pages are 5 sessions each.
get_map_sessions.title: Get Map Sessions

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_top_players.description:
Top players on a map, ranked by playtime, with optional name search.

`player_name` (minimum 2 characters) filters to matching players; pages are 10 players
each.
get_map_top_players.title: Get Map Top Players

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_detail.description:
Full profile for a player on a server: playtime, rank and related stats in one call.

Backed by `PlayerWorker`'s cache. When nothing current is cached this falls back to db.
get_player_detail.title: Get Player Detail

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.

get_player_global_playtime_heatmap.description:
A player's playtime by day, summed across every server they've played on.

`player_id` may be `"me"` or a numeric Steam ID. Communities where the target anonymized
themselves are excluded for viewers without permission for those communities.
get_player_global_playtime_heatmap.title: Get Player Global Playtime Heatmap

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_hours_of_day.description: A player's playtime broken down by hour of day. Backed by `PlayerWorker`'s cache.
get_player_hours_of_day.title: Get Player Hours Of Day

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_infractions.description: A player's infraction (ban/mute) history on a server, newest first.
get_player_infractions.title: Get Player Infractions

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_leaderboard.description:
Paginated, ranked player leaderboard for a server.

`mode` selects which playtime figure to sort/rank by (`Casual`, `TryHard`, `Mixed`,
`Total`). `player_name` (minimum 2 characters) filters to matching players instead of
paginating the full leaderboard; pages are 5 players each. Anonymized players show as
"Anonymous" unless the requester is that player, a superuser, or a community admin.
get_player_leaderboard.title: Get Player Leaderboard

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_most_played_maps.description: A player's most-played maps on a server. Backed by `PlayerWorker`'s cache.
get_player_most_played_maps.title: Get Player Most Played Maps

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_online_heatmap.description: A player's online activity heatmap (by day/hour). Backed by `PlayerWorker`'s cache.
get_player_online_heatmap.title: Get Player Online Heatmap

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_regions.description: A player's playtime broken down by geographic region. Backed by `PlayerWorker`'s cache.
get_player_regions.title: Get Player Regions

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.
arguments.session_id: Session ID: a map session's time_id (get_map_sessions) or a player session's id (get_player_sessions), matching the tool.

get_player_session_player_count_graph.description:
Player-count chart for the duration of a single player's session.

Returns the server's player-count time series over the span of the given player session,
downsampled to at most 1500 peak-preserving points. Cached briefly while the session is
still active, for a long time once it has ended.
get_player_session_player_count_graph.title: Get Player Session Player Count Graph

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_sessions.title: Get Player Sessions

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_sessions_graph.description: Chart data for a player's session history on a server. Backed by `PlayerWorker`'s cache.
get_player_sessions_graph.title: Get Player Sessions Graph

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_server_current_match.description:
The server's currently active map session and its live match (round) state, if any.
Cached for 60 seconds.
get_server_current_match.title: Get Server Current Match

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_server_event_count_graph.description:
Time series of how often a given event type occurred.

Counts rows in `player_server_activity` matching `event_type`, bucketed to the minute and
then downsampled to roughly 360 points. `start`/`end` must span at most 1 day.
get_server_event_count_graph.title: Get Server Event Count Graph

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_server_maps_played_graph.description:
Maps played on a server within a date range.

`start`/`end` must span at most 2 days.
get_server_maps_played_graph.title: Get Server Maps Played Graph

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_server_player_count_graph.description:
Unique/concurrent player-count chart over an arbitrary date range.

`start`/`end` must span at most 1 year. Bucket width is chosen automatically based on the
range (from 5-minute buckets for half-day windows up to 2-day buckets for year-long
ones); ranges of 6 hours or less are served from an in-memory hourly chunk cache instead.
get_server_player_count_graph.title: Get Server Player Count Graph

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_server_players_in_range.title: Get Server Players In Range

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_server_stats.description:
Total playtime, player count and country count for a server, both all-time and this week.

Cached for 1 day.
get_server_stats.title: Get Server Stats

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_server_top_players.description:
Top 20 players on a server, ranked by playtime within a preset time frame.

`time_frame` selects a fixed window (`Today`, `Week1`, `Week2`, `Month1`, `Month6`,
`Year1`); cache TTL scales with the window size. Player names are anonymized per the
requester's identity.
get_server_top_players.title: Get Server Top Players

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

list_maps.description:
Paginated, filterable, sortable list of a server's played maps.

`sorted_by` picks the ranking metric (last played, total/cumulative hours, session
count, or unique players); `filter` narrows to `Casual`/`TryHard`/`Available`/
`Favorite`/`HasLaser`; `search_map` filters by name substring. Pages are 25 maps each.
list_maps.title: List Maps

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

list_online_players.description:
Players currently connected to a server.

A session counts as "currently connected" if it was verified within the last 20 minutes.
Anonymized players show as "Anonymous" unless the requester is that player, a superuser,
or a community admin.
list_online_players.title: List Online Players

list_servers.description:
List all communities and their servers.

Returns every tracked community together with its servers, each server's current
player count (capped at `max_players`) and currently-played map. Cached for 60 seconds.
list_servers.title: List Servers

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

list_time_regions.description:
List map regions used for heat/region charts.

Returns up to 10 rows from the `region_time` view. `server_id` is validated but not
otherwise used to filter the result.
list_time_regions.title: List Time Regions

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

search_maps.description: Search a server's maps by name, for autocomplete. Up to 20 substring matches.
search_maps.title: Search Maps

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

search_players.description:
Search players on a server by name, for autocomplete.

`player_name` must be at least 3 characters. Matches the requester's own player ID first,
then substring name matches (case-insensitive), up to 20 results. Anonymized players show
as "Anonymous" unless the requester is that player, a superuser, or a community admin.
search_players.title: Search Players

search_players_global.description:
Search and paginate players across every community.

`page` is a 0-indexed page of 10 players, ranked by total playtime. `search` filters by
player name (case-insensitive substring, minimum 2 characters); results are cached for 60
seconds when unfiltered, computed live when searching.
search_players_global.title: Search Players Global
